collection.title: Peugeot 407 Saloon 2004 to 2011 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Peugeot 407 Saloon 2004 to 2011 will fit, this model requires a 28" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
